money-pay.title: How clients pay
money-pay.none: Add your UPI ID or bank details so clients can pay you.
money-pay.marked: When they pay by UPI, record it here. It shows as marked paid by you.
money-pay.shareNote: Your own app opens with the words filled in. Attach the file and send it yourself.
money-pay.mail.draft: Your mail app opened an email with {file} attached. Check it and send it. If it has no Send button, use Forward or Edit as new.
money-pay.mail.draftNoTo: Your mail app opened an email with {file} attached. Add the client's email address, then send it. If it has no Send button, use Forward or Edit as new.
money-pay.mail.link: Your mail app opened with the words filled in, but a mail link cannot carry a file. Attach {file}, then press send.
money-pay.mail.none: No mail app opened on this computer. {file} is saved, so you can attach it to an email yourself.
money-pay.wa.app: WhatsApp opened with the invoice note. A WhatsApp link cannot carry a file, so attach {file} and send it yourself.
money-pay.wa.web: WhatsApp opened in your browser with the invoice note. A WhatsApp link cannot carry a file, so attach {file} and send it yourself.
money-pay.receipt.whatsapp: Send a thank-you receipt on WhatsApp
money-pay.receipt.opened: WhatsApp is open with the words. Attach {file} and press send there.
money-pay.receipt.openedWeb: WhatsApp is open with the words. Save the receipt, attach it and press send there.
money-pay.showPdf: Show the PDF in its folder
money-pay.showFile: Show the file in its folder
money-pay.linkAsk: Make a Razorpay link for {amount} on your own account? Razorpay sends nothing to the client; you share the link.
money-pay.linkStatus.created: Waiting for payment. Chausar asks Razorpay while the app is open.
money-pay.linkStatus.partially_paid: Part paid. Chausar asks Razorpay while the app is open.
money-pay.part.percent: Share of the order, in percent
money-pay.part.label: Name on the invoice
money-pay.settings.label: Billing
money-pay.settings.due: Days until an invoice is due
money-pay.settings.razorpayNote: Your own Razorpay account. The keys stay in this computer's protected storage.
money-pay.settings.connected: Keys saved for your {mode} account, ending {hint}.
